title: Metric Gaming & Product Health
description: The senior-altitude cluster: spot how a metric will be gamed before you ship it, design for robustness against coordinated or adversarial behavior, and reason about product health as a portfolio rather than a single number.
outcomes: You'll anticipate how a metric gets gamed, design a more robust or counter-metric-guarded version, and weigh a strategic product-health trade-off that no single metric captures.
